description: This Dart file is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the app structure, routing logic, webview-based HTML content rendering, asset management, and diagnostics for resource verification.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, manages routing and route-to-asset mapping.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: Widget displaying a list of available screens and diagnostics route.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Wrapper widget to display a local HTML asset within the app scaffold.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: Stateful widget that loads an HTML asset, injects base href and styles, and renders via WebView.

classes.name: DiagnosticsScreen
classes.description: Widget to diagnose and verify referenced external assets within a selected HTML.

classes.name: UnknownRouteScreen
classes.description: Simple 404 error screen for unknown routes.

methods.name: loadHtml
methods.description: Loads the HTML asset, inlines CSS, injects base href, and renders in WebView.

methods.name: _injectBaseHrefAndRewrite
methods.description: Rewrites relative links in HTML and injects <base> tag to ensure correct asset resolution.

methods.name: _ensureViewportMeta
methods.description: Ensures that a viewport meta tag is present for proper mobile scaling.

methods.name: _inlineCssIntoHead
methods.description: Injects paired CSS as <style> block into HTML head.

methods.name: _rewriteCssUrls
methods.description: Rewrites CSS url(...) references to absolute /assets/... paths.

methods.name: _pairedCssPath
methods.description: Derives the CSS filename paired with a given HTML filename.

methods.name: _fallbackErrorHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML fallback page shown when loading asset fails.

methods.name: _escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes HTML special characters for safe inclusion.

methods.name: __loadHtml
methods.description: (Private) loads the HTML asset, its paired CSS, and prepares the full HTML for WebView.
